name: dev-workflow
description: Development pipeline roles and the flow that wires them — subagents each with a single responsibility, plus the step definitions an external graph engine schedules them from. The engine is a separate package; what ships here is the flow, not the runtime.

interface.shortDescription: Development pipeline roles, and the flow that schedules them
interface.longDescription: Twelve subagents covering the roles an orchestrated development flow needs — spec authoring, design review, implementation, e2e authoring and execution, accessibility, security and performance checks, incremental code review, debugging, research, and release preparation. Each is one responsibility with explicit boundaries, and the separations between them are load-bearing: whoever produces does not verify. Alongside them ship fourteen step definitions with their gates, installed into a project by install-dev-workflow and scheduled by an external graph engine.
